title: Support for Students with Special Needs during Circuit Breaker Period
what_it_is: Support for Students with Special Needs during Circuit Breaker Period

sections.label: Teachers prepared lesson packages
sections.summary: Teachers prepared lesson packages delivered to families ahead of time so parents could guide children through HBL.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Teachers prepared lesson packages that were delivered to the families ahead of time so the parents could use these to guide the children through HBL.

sections.label: Schools loaned devices and internet
sections.summary: Schools loaned computing devices, dongles and routers and provided SIM cards to students without devices or internet access for full HBL.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Schools also loaned computing devices, dongles, routers and provided SIM cards to students without devices or internet access to ensure that they could participate in full HBL.

sections.label: Allied health services re-categorised essential
sections.summary: With the circuit breaker extended to 1 June 2020, MOH re-categorised allied health services, including therapy services, as essential services from 29 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: With the extension of the circuit breaker to 1 June 2020, MOH has re-categorised allied health services out of the public healthcare institutions, including therapy services, as essential services, effective 29 April 2020.

sections.label: Parents gave feedback on SEN families
sections.summary: Over 200 parents led by Sun Mei Lan of Friends of ASD Families provided useful feedback on families with children of SEN across age groups.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: A group of over 200 parents led by Sun Mei Lan of Friends of ASD Families has provided very useful feedback on the experience of families with children of SEN across age groups.

sections.label: Sessions for physical interaction
sections.summary: On more sessions for physical interaction, there is a limited service where some children, especially those with high needs, return to schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: On the question of whether we can have more sessions for physical interaction, there are two kinds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: There is, of course, the limited service where some of the children have been allowed to come back to schools, especially for those who have particularly high needs.

sections.label: Teachers ensured routine for SEN
sections.summary: Teachers made great effort to ensure routine, which is important for some children who deal with SEN.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The other thing that the teachers have made a great effort to do is to try and ensure that there is routine, because for those who deal with SEN, you will know that routine is very important for some of these children.

sections.label: HBL learning lessons
sections.summary: The speaker says the period of HBL has produced many learning lessons, as mentioned yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As I mentioned yesterday, this period of HBL has thrown up a lot of learning lessons.
